title: pvSliceWithPlane
body:
## pvSliceWithPlane

Fast, multithreaded plane cut (vtkPVPlaneCutter) of any dataset, composite dataset, overlapping AMR or hyper tree grid, producing polygonal data with interpolated point data and transferred cell data. It accepts only planes (Plane or Axis Aligned Plane) and, for unstructured input, can build a sphere tree to accelerate repeated cuts. Choose it over pvSlice when a plane is all you need and speed matters, or when slicing AMR data at a chosen level; use pvSlice for spheres, boxes, cylinders or offset copies.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Duplicated points along cell edges are not merged by default; enable Mergeduplicatedpointsintheslice before operations that need a connected surface, such as connectivity or feature edges.
- Set the Plane options explicitly; ParaView's initial origin may depend on the input bounds.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `SliceWithPlane`. Identity: `filters/SliceWithPlane`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input of the slice filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); composite data (multiblock or partitioned collections) (vtkCompositeDataSet); hyper-tree grids (adaptive AMR-like trees) (vtkHyperTreeGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet","vtkCompositeDataSet","vtkHyperTreeGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `BuildHierarchy` | If enabled and input is not an Image Data, Tree hierarchy will be computed, for a faster slice computation. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `BuildTree` | If enabled and input is not an Image Data, Sphere Tree will be computed, for a faster slice computation. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ComputeNormals` | If enabled, compute the normal on each cell. Since all output cells are coplanar, the normal generated is simply the normal of the plane used to slice with. By default, computing of normals is disabled. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `GeneratePolygons` | If enabled and input is a vtkImageData, vtkStructuredGrid or vtkRectilinearGrid, output slice will consist of polygons instead of only triangles. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `InterpolateAttributes` | If enabled, interpolate attribute data. By default this is enabled. Point data is always interpolated. Cell data is transferred unless input is an image data. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Level` | Set maximum slice resolution. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `Mergeduplicatedpointsintheslice` | This parameter controls whether to merge duplicated points in the slice. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `PlaneType` | This property sets the parameters of the plane function. | `{"type":"typed proxy","choices":["Axis Aligned Plane","Plane"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `{"type":"Axis Aligned Plane"}` |
| `UseDual` | If checked, uses the dual of the hyper tree grid. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `UseNativeCutter` | This property specifies whether the ParaView's generic dataset cutter is used instead of the specialized AMR cutter. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

### Nested `PlaneType` → `Axis Aligned Plane`

Syntax: `{"type":"Axis Aligned Plane","options":{...}}`. Native identity: `implicit_functions/Axis Aligned Plane`. Omitted nested options retain native values on subsequent visits.

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PlaneType.options.AlwaysSnapToNearestAxis` | When true, ParaView replaces Normal by the coordinate axis of its largest absolute component, so the plane is always perpendicular to x, y or z. The snapped normal is always positive ([-1, 0, 0] becomes [1, 0, 0]), and tied components are all set to 1 ([1, 1, 0] stays [1, 1, 0]) rather than resolved to one axis. When false, Normal is used as given. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `PlaneType.options.Normal` | Direction perpendicular to the plane, [nx, ny, nz]. It orients the plane and defines its positive side: points toward which the normal points have positive implicit-function values Normal·(x − Origin), points on the other side negative; clip and extract operations use this sign to decide which side to keep. VTK does not normalize the vector, so its length scales the function value. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `PlaneType.options.Offset` | Moves the plane along its normal without changing Origin: the plane actually used passes through Origin + Offset × Normal. Positive values move it toward the side the normal points to. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `PlaneType.options.Origin` | A point the plane passes through, as [x, y, z] in the input’s own coordinates. With Normal it defines the infinite plane Normal·(x − Origin) = 0 used to clip, slice, cut or select. Moving Origin along the normal shifts the plane; moving it within the plane changes nothing. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
